## Layer

- [ ] systemic (content inside the structure)
- [ ] metasystemic (changes the lens — requires a proposal + usually a vote, see [GOVERNANCE.md](../GOVERNANCE.md))

## Suggested label

- `systemic-change` — cards, data, queries, labels, sources, dashboard content
- `metasystemic-change` — tabs, governance, architecture, moderation rules, visual grammar, constitutional structure
- `correction` — factual, methodological, or data fixes
- `data-source` — new or changed data sources
- `governance` — voting, moderation, maintainership, constitutional changes
- `agent-interface` — MCP, API, stream, or machine-readable context changes
- also: `tab-change`, `needs-methodology`, `needs-source`, `needs-bias-note`, `good-first-card`

## The four questions (for any card/data change)

- Where did this data come from?
- How was it transformed?
- When was it last updated?
- What should the viewer be careful about?

## Checklist

- [ ] Sources cited
- [ ] Method / reason stated
- [ ] Known limitations + update cadence noted
- [ ] Uncertainty disclosed
- [ ] No political conclusion smuggled in
- [ ] Impartial title

Metasystemic only:

- [ ] Written proposal
- [ ] Bias-impact note
- [ ] Migration plan
- [ ] Rollback plan
- [ ] Public discussion period (>= 14 days)
- [ ] Vote linked

---

- [ ] I affirm the contributor pledge ([CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)).
